coverage.main: Read all ten pages of arXiv 1812.11720v4 (8 July 2019): Sections I-XI, Tables I-V, Figures 1-5 and references. The corpus lists only the arXiv record.
coverage.supplement: No appendix or supplement is included or referenced.
coverage.excluded_results: The paper infers network depth from execution time (Tables I-II, IV, V; Figures 2-4) and reconstructs a substitute by reinforcement-learning architecture search (Table III: substitute versus target test accuracy). Adversarial examples are mentioned only as a motivation; no adversarial example is generated or evaluated.

f1.evidence: Target and substitute CIFAR-10 test accuracies are reported for extraction fidelity, not for a transfer-attack evaluation.

f4.evidence: Reported values are timings, regression errors and accuracies.

f6.evidence: No code is linked; with no transfer configuration this is neither a transfer recomputability success nor a failure.

artifact_checks.result: Downloaded and hashed the arXiv v4 PDF; the paper links no code, data or models.

bounds_exclusion.reason: No transferred misclassification rate is reported.

limitations: Retained in the frozen corpus with non-applicability reasons (model extraction without an adversarial-example evaluation), as for ranks 27 and 36.
